title: Probability Signal Feed 001
purpose: Feed the Probability Lab with weighted signals that can move scenario probabilities up or down.
boundary: Signals are not conclusions. They are inputs. They must be attached to source routes, verified source cards, record intake tasks or verified record cards before they can carry high weight.

weightScale.3: strong signal / official route or preliminary VRC exists
weightScale.4: very strong signal / full VRC or direct official record

signals.title: SEC filing routes established for major technology and finance targets
signals.whyItMatters: Official filing routes allow the site to convert broad power-layer claims into record-backed business, risk and governance claims.

signals.title: SEC filing metadata feed added to build process
signals.whyItMatters: The system can refresh filing metadata automatically during builds, making the evidence engine less manual.

signals.title: Record intake queue defines first 12 verification tasks
signals.whyItMatters: The site now has a concrete queue for converting routes into proof cards.

signals.title: Source route cards define what records can and cannot prove
signals.whyItMatters: This prevents forecasts from treating links as proof before records are classified.

signals.title: Power targets are grouped by infrastructure layer
signals.whyItMatters: The category map lets the machine reason by layer instead of isolated names.

signals.title: OpenAI policy route exists but private deployment records remain missing
signals.whyItMatters: Official policy pages can support policy-boundary checks, but private deployments require separate records.

signals.title: USAspending route added for public contract searches
signals.whyItMatters: Public contract searches can convert public-sector dependency from inference into record-backed evidence when awards are found.

signals.title: DOJ Epstein disclosure route added as critical file-level review task
signals.whyItMatters: Official disclosure routes let the system separate file-level review from unsupported name-counting.

nextAction: Generate a probability snapshot from scenario priors and signal impacts.
